description: TBEST is a software platform listed in awesome-transit (MobilityData), a community list of transit data, APIs and tools under the section "Using Data > Agency Tools", published or maintained by as named on tbest.org. TBEST (Transit Boardings Estimation and Simulation Tool) is an effort to develop a multi-faceted GIS-based modeling, planning and analysis tool which integrates socio-economic, land use, and transit network data into a platform for scenario-based transit ridership estimation and analysis. Funded by the Florida Department of Transportation. Free to use but not open-source. Coverage: as described in the entry; the linked page was not read. The list files it under "Using Data > Agency Tools". The entry links to tbest.org. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. The entry links to a product or project page, not a repository, so open-source status was not confirmed and is recorded as false. It can support transport and planning studies.
